disputes.title: How long is the platinum?
disputes.a: About 200 hours in one playthrough (60–80 story, ~100 checklist, ~10 cleanup).
disputes.call: Plan for 200 hours on the PowerPyx roadmap; the extra 50 is cleanup variance, not a different route.

disputes.title: How many trophies are hidden?
disputes.call: We count 28, following the tracker consensus (TrueTrophies, PSNProfiles, Insider Gaming) and the official split.

disputes.title: Does the Chapter 1 meditation count?
disputes.a: It adds +1 to the counter, but PowerPyx says it is pending confirmation whether it is required for the trophy — the final meditation might count as +2 instead.
disputes.b: Beebom and CryptoGames count 18 meditations at 10 spots with the Chapter 1 one included.
disputes.call: Do it in Chapter 1 anyway — it costs nothing and is the only safe reading.

disputes.title: Race Against Yago — missable, but does it cost a trophy?
disputes.a: PowerPyx lists Yago's chain (Join a Street Race, Bumper to Bumper, Race Against Yago, Brother to Brother) as counting for Strangers & Freaks.
disputes.b: KeenGamer, AlcastHQ and HudWire report that the missable optional missions are not required for the platinum or 100% completion.
disputes.call: Do it the moment the hourglass appears in Chapter 3 (Jason) — free to do, and Yago's strand counts either way.

disputes.title: Is the final mission Chapter 5?
disputes.a: The official description says only 'Complete the final mission.'
disputes.b: Beebom and CULTR word it as Chapter 5.
disputes.call: We follow the official wording and treat Chapter 5 as the final chapter; the trophy pops at the ending either way.

roadmap.title: Chapter 1 — Arrival
roadmap.text: Open with Gone Fishing, finish Chapter 1, and do the first meditation on Lucia's balcony at Jason's house before the chapter ends — it is the game's only missable trophy. Save manually at the start of the chapter.
points: End of Chapter 1: the first meditation (Positive Mental Attitude) disappears — save before leaving Chapter 1.

roadmap.title: Chapter 2 — Welcome to Vice City
roadmap.text: Chapter 2 opens with What's in the Bag?. After Coffee Break you can play as both Jason and Lucia — the last meditation only unlocks then.
points: After 'Coffee Break' you can switch characters — some quests are Lucia-only or Jason-only.

roadmap.title: Chapter 3 — Vice City
roadmap.text: Chapter 3 opens with Welcome to Vice City. Yago's chain runs here — Race Against Yago shows an hourglass and disappears if you wait.
points: Race Against Yago (Chapter 3): a time-sensitive hourglass mission — do it the moment it appears.

roadmap.title: Chapter 4
roadmap.text: Bank vault robberies open through an optional mission in Chapter 4 — there are 8 vaults and 100% needs all of them.
points: No mission replay anywhere: keep a manual save at the start and end of every chapter.

roadmap.title: Chapter 5 — Finale
roadmap.text: Finish the story. After the ending you return to free-roam and the 100% Completion checklist unlocks — everything it needs is still accessible.
points: The ending is not a point of no return for the checklist — free-roam continues after the story.

roadmap.title: 100% Completion Checklist
roadmap.text: Progress > Stats > 100% Completion. The checklist is closer to 60% true completion: 200 of 277 vehicles, 100 of 255 animals, 50 of 66 weapons, 70 of 80 challenges, 15 of 18 meditations, 300 stunts — plus every robbery, underwater discovery, shooting range, drone race and Bret quest.
points: Only 70 of 80 challenges are needed — skip the nastiest ten.

roadmap.title: Strangers & Freaks + cleanup
roadmap.text: Finish the 8 stranger strands and the character questlines, then mop up whatever did not pop. Every quest giver tied to a trophy comes back after the story.
points: Character-locked quests: Andy is Lucia-only; Tyrone and Bret are Jason-only — switch characters to finish them.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: Earn the other 54 trophies in one playthrough — no online, no DLC, no New Game+ needed.

steps.t: Earn the other 54 trophies; the platinum pops automatically once the last one lands.
One playthrough is enough — there are no difficulty settings and no New Game+.
No online trophies: all 55 are offline single-player.
Budget about 200 hours (PowerPyx); other guides put it at 200–250 hours.
Keep cheats off the whole run — cheats disable trophies and saving.

steps.t: Play the opening mission Gone Fishing — the first main mission of Chapter 1.

If you are chasing the platinum, save manually at the start of Chapter 1 — there is no mission replay.
Cheats disable trophies, so leave them off from the first mission.
It is the first trophy most players earn, since the mission is the game's opening.

The story runs 60–80 hours across five chapters (PowerPyx).

Story missions pop on completion with no gold medal to chase.

The trophy pops automatically when the mission ends; it cannot be missed.
Story missions pop on completion with no gold medal to chase.
No mission replay: save manually before story missions you cannot redo.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Reach 100% on the completion checklist (Progress > Stats), which unlocks after the story.

steps.t: Finish the story first — the 100% Completion checklist appears under Progress > Stats > 100% Completion after the ending.
The checklist is closer to 60% true completion: most side quests are not required and collectibles only partly.
Scan 200 of the 277 base vehicle models with the WAiNK app — you do not need all of them.
Study 100 of the 255 animals through the binoculars — looking is enough, no hunting needed.
Collect 50 of the 66 weapons.
Complete 70 of the 80 challenges — skip the nastiest ten.
Complete 15 of the 18 meditations.
Complete 300 stunts (the trophy needs 250; the checklist needs 300).
Every robbery, underwater discovery, shooting range, drone race and Bret quest is required.
Any progress made during the story already counts toward the checklist.
The checklist is the hardest trophy in the game (PowerPyx) and the longest single grind, about 100 hours.
Track it in-game under Progress > Stats — the checklist only becomes viewable after the story.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunts of any kind across Leonida.

steps.t: Complete any 250 stunts — stunt jumps, flights under bridges, knife flights and base jumps all count.
PowerPyx counts 397 stunts in total across the map, so there is plenty of slack.
The 100% checklist needs 300 stunts — keep going past 250 if you want A Long Road too.
Stunt jumps, bridge flights, knife flights and base jumps are the four stunt types PowerPyx lists.
Flights under bridges count as stunts — fly low under Leonida's bridges.
Knife flights — flying sideways close to buildings — also count toward the total.
Base jumps count too — jump from high places and open the parachute late.
Progress is tracked in-game — check Progress > Stats for your counts.
Any vehicle works — use fast cars for jumps and planes for flights.
Stunts done during the story already count — you do not need a separate grind session.
The trophy is silver and one of the six silvers in the list.
Do not use cheats while grinding — cheats disable trophies and saving.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once.

steps.t: Try each of the 9 activity types once — fishing, hunting, golf, shooting ranges, pool, basketball, a video game, a race and a stunt.
Fishing: fish anywhere — beating Cal is a separate trophy, just try it once here.
Hunting: study or hunt an animal — studying through binoculars is enough to count as trying it.
Golf, pool and basketball are found at their venues around Leonida — play one round or game of each.
Shooting ranges: enter a range and finish one challenge — gold is not needed here.
Arcade: complete one arcade game; races and stunts come naturally while playing.
The trophy pops the moment the ninth type is tried — none of them needs to be won or mastered.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in every one of the 42 Shooting Range challenges.

steps.t: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges.
Shooting ranges are one of the 9 activity types — enter a range to start a challenge.
Every shooting range challenge is required for the 100% checklist too.
Gold medals need accuracy and speed — take your time on the first run to learn the targets, then go for gold.
Use the range's own weapons — challenges are built around them.
Retry a challenge as often as you like — ranges stay open after the story.
Track progress in the range menu — gold medals are marked per challenge.
Do the ranges during the story when you pass one — progress counts toward the checklist from the start.
The trophy is silver and one of the six silvers in the list.
Cheats disable trophies and saving, so keep them off while grinding.

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at all 14 locations.

steps.t: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location — there are 14 of them.
Top Fun drone races are one of the activities — find the Top Fun markers on the map.
Every drone race is required for the 100% checklist too.
Win means first place — learn each course's line before racing for the win.
Drone races can be retried — a loss costs nothing but time.
Races done during the story already count toward the checklist.
The trophy is bronze and pops when the 14th location is won.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos

steps.t: Win 20 different races — street races, drone races and other race types all count.
Each race counts once — winning the same race twice does not add to the 20.
Yago's street races count — Join a Street Race starts his chain in Chapter 3.
Top Fun drone race wins count too — there are 14 locations.
Races are one of the 9 activity types for Master of None.
Race wins during the story already count — no separate grind is needed.

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.

steps.t: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge — Cal is the fishing rival.
Fishing is one of the 9 activity types — fish anywhere to start.
The challenge is a fishing contest against Cal, not just catching a fish.
Fishing needs patience: wait for the bite, then reel steadily.
The challenge can be retried if you lose to Cal.
Just trying fishing once counts toward Master of None — beating Cal is the extra step.
Cheats disable trophies and saving, so keep them off.

steps.t: Complete one arcade game — any arcade machine counts.

Find an arcade machine at its venue and play the game through to its end.
Completing means finishing the game, not just starting it.
Arcade games can be retried as often as you like.
The trophy pops the moment the game ends.
Cheats disable trophies and saving, so keep them off.

Quest givers tied to a trophy come back after the story, so the chain can be finished in free-roam.

The trophy pops when Andy's final mission ends.

trophies.guide: Complete 8 stranger mission strands across Leonida.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 spots across Leonida — do the Chapter 1 one first, it is missable.

steps.t: Meditate at every spot across Leonida — 18 meditations at 10 spots in total.
MISSABLE FIRST: do the Chapter 1 meditation on Lucia's balcony at Jason's house — it disappears after Chapter 1.
After the mission Down to Earth, follow Lucia to the balcony when she suggests meditating and accept.
Most spots count twice — Jason and Lucia can each meditate at the same spot.
You can play as both characters after Chapter 2 (Coffee Break) — the last meditation only unlocks then.
Only 15 of 18 meditations are needed for 100% completion — all 18 are needed for this trophy.
Spots 2–3 Smooth Sand: sandbar off the west coast of Capri, Mariana County.
Spots 4–5 Swamp: wooden dock by a lookout tower in Buckskin Swamp, Kelly County.
Spots 6–7 Worn Stone: bank of the Emerald River at Camp Moonflower, Kelly County.
Spots 8–9 Red Rocks: Manifest Canyon, Kelly County, near the train tracks and highway.
Spots 10–15 Water Wheel, Jutting Cliff and Waterfall: paper mill in Lummox County, Mount Kalaga National Park, and north-west of Tallaloko.

Spots 16–18 Seaside and Ascent: rocky beach in Leonard County, then the stone circle at the Mount Kalaga peak — the Ascent only appears after all other spots are done. Track progress under Progress > Collections > Exploration > Meditations.

trophies.guide: Hunt the unique animal for Bret (Jason-only chain).

steps.t: Complete 50 Challenges — the game has 80 challenges in eight groups of ten.
Only 50 are needed for the trophy; the 100% checklist needs 70 of 80.
Challenges cover combat, driving, exploration and more — pick the groups you like.
Skip the nastiest ten for the checklist — the trophy needs only 50.
Challenge progress is tracked in the Stats menu.
Challenges done during the story already count.
Stunts, races and shooting ranges all feed challenge groups — overlap your grinds.
Meditations feed challenges too — 15 of 18 count for the checklist.

trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star wanted level with your partner beside you.

steps.t: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
Play with your partner — the trophy needs the two of you together.
Build a 4-star wanted level, then break line of sight and hide until it clears.
Use the map edge, water or a hiding spot to lose the cops.
Do not get caught or killed while the wanted level is active — that ends the attempt.
The trophy pops the moment the wanted level clears with your partner beside you.

trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops in a row with your partner, keeping your wanted level.

steps.t: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
Rob a shop, then move straight to the next — do not stop between robberies.
Keep your wanted level the whole time — losing it breaks the chain.
Pick three shops close together so the run is quick.
Your partner must be with you for all three robberies.
The trophy pops after the third shop in a row.

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Down 5 enemies in one use of Combat Focus.

steps.t: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
Combat Focus is the slow-motion aiming mode — trigger it in a firefight.
Find a spot with at least 5 enemies grouped together before triggering it.
Use a fast weapon so all 5 go down before Focus ends.

trophies.guide: Leave VCIA by an unscheduled route.

Head to VCIA and leave by an unscheduled route instead of a normal flight.

steps.t: Kinda hot in these Rhinos — deal with the Rhino tanks.
Rhinos are military tanks — they appear at high wanted levels.
Build a high wanted level to draw Rhinos out, then deal with them.
Use heavy weapons or explosives — small arms will not dent a tank.
Stay mobile — a Rhino's cannon one-shots most cover.
The trophy pops once the Rhino encounter is handled.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being seen.

steps.t: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
Plan the robbery: watch the guards and cameras before moving.
Stay out of sight — detection ends the attempt.
Move quietly and take the goods without raising the alarm.
Leave the store clean — the trophy pops once you are out undetected.
If you are spotted, leave and retry — the store can be robbed again.
Cheats disable trophies and saving, so keep them off.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 of the 8 bank vaults and escape (all 8 for 100%).

steps.t: Rob 5 Bank Vaults and escape.
Bank vault robberies open through an optional mission in Chapter 4 — there are 8 vaults.
Only 5 are needed for the trophy, but 100% needs all 8 — do all of them while you are at it.
Plan each vault: get in, crack it, get out before the response arrives.
Escaping counts — the trophy needs the robbery and the getaway.
Every robbery is required for the 100% checklist.

steps.t: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.

Stop the truck, crack it open and take the cash.
Escaping counts — the trophy needs the robbery and the getaway.

steps.t: Explore all of Leonida — clear the fog from the entire map.
The map is split into counties and areas — visit every one of them to clear the fog.
Drive every road and visit every town — the fog clears as you go.
Use the WAiNK app to find landmarks you have not visited yet.
Exploration done during the story already counts.
The trophy pops when the last area is discovered.

trophies.guide: Rob one Illegal Operation for each of the 9 gangs.

Illegal Operations are gang-run businesses — find their markers on the map.
One operation per gang is enough — nine robberies in total.
Every robbery is required for the 100% checklist.
Plan each hit: get in, take the goods, get out before the gang responds.

Play a game of bowling and follow through — finish the game.

No guide has pinned the exact trigger — the description is all the guides quote.

The partnership theme runs through the story — keep playing partner content and it should pop.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Perform 500 actions that affect your Criminal Profile.

steps.t: Choices made (for better or worse) — perform 500 actions that affect your Criminal Profile.
Your Criminal Profile tracks your choices — every crime and decision feeds it.
Play normally and the count climbs — crimes, choices and side actions all add up.
Watch out for the Irredeemable profile, which cannot be undone — it is tied to the same choices.
The count is tracked by PlayStation (PSN tracks a count to 500).
The trophy pops at the 500th counted action.
